title: Mentoring a New Employee
paragraphs: When a new hire joined her department clearly overwhelmed by the volume of information during onboarding, Marwa volunteered to informally mentor him, despite having no official responsibility to do so.
She spent extra time each week answering his questions and introducing him to key colleagues, remembering clearly how isolating her own first weeks at the company had felt without similar guidance.
Within two months, the new employee was performing confidently and had started helping other new hires himself, directly modeling the mentorship approach that Marwa had shown him.

Reflecting on this, Marwa realized that investing unpaid time in someone else's success ultimately strengthened the whole team, creating a culture of support that benefited everyone, including herself.
